record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.original_question: Let D be an admissible subcategory of Db(X) that admits Serre-invariant stability conditions, and suppose the numerical Grothendieck group N(D) has rank 2. Is there a unique orbit of Serre-invariant stability conditions under the action of the universal cover of GL_2^+(R)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a smooth projective variety over the complex numbers, and let D ⊂ D^b(X) be an admissible triangulated subcategory of its bounded derived category of coherent sheaves. Assume that D admits Serre-invariant Bridgeland stability conditions, i.e. stability conditions σ on D such that S_D · σ lies in the same GL_2^+(R)-orbit (for the universal cover) as σ, where S_D denotes the Serre functor of D. Suppose furthermore that the numerical Grothendieck group N(D) has rank 2.

Question: Do all Serre-invariant stability conditions on D form a single orbit under the action of the universal cover of GL_2^+(R)?
artifact.status_search_result: Uniqueness of the Serre-invariant stability orbit has been established under additional hypotheses: for fractional Calabi–Yau categories of dimension ≤ 2 with N(D) of rank 2 generated by suitable objects E with small hom^1(E,E), via a criterion of Pertusi–Yang and related work (e.g. Feyzbakhsh–Pertusi). This covers important cases such as the Kuznetsov component of a cubic threefold. A fully general answer for arbitrary admissible D with Serre-invariant stability and rank-2 numerical Grothendieck group does not appear to be settled in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Serre-invariant stability conditions and Ulrich bundles on cubic threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: We prove a general criterion which ensures that a fractional Calabi-Yau category of dimension ≤ 2 admits a unique Serre-invariant stability condition, up to the action of the universal cover of GL_2^+(R).
status_evidence.claim: Uniqueness is proved under fractional Calabi–Yau and rank-2 hypotheses with extra generation conditions, not in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Serre-invariant stability conditions and Ulrich bundles (EPIGA)
status_evidence.snippet: All known stability conditions on Ku(X) for X a cubic threefold are Serre-invariant and lie in the same orbit of the universal cover of GL_2^+(R).
status_evidence.claim: Confirms partial uniqueness results in concrete geometric examples.
